QUOTE: "If you define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` yourself without a replacement, the library substitutes `platform_calloc_uninit`, which always returns NULL"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninitialised calloc stub returns NULL, but it never says the uninitialised free does nothing. It also presents the stub only as a side case, not as the pointers' failing default.
